importantNotes: 'I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth' (v. 4).
Diotrephes 'loves to be first' (v. 9) — a warning against self-centered church leaders.
3 John is the shortest book of the Bible by word count.
The letter shows the practical side of early church life — hospitality was essential.
Three characters represent three types of believers: faithful Gaius, proud Diotrephes, reputable Demetrius.

chapters.1: Praise for Gaius's faithful hospitality; condemnation of Diotrephes' pride; commendation of Demetrius.
